inlineSql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.TRAN_NAME) AS SrNo,B.TRAN_NAME As Name,Format(SUM(A.ITM_GWT),'0.000') As GrWt,Format(SUM(A.ITM_OTH_WT),'0.000') As OthWt,Format(SUM(A.ITM_NWT),'0.000') As NetWt,Format(SUM(A.KR_MINO_WT),'0.000') As MinoWt,Format(SUM(A.DM_PCS),'0') As DmPcs,Format(SUM(A.DM_WT),'0.000') As DmWt, Format(SUM(A.ITM_GHT_WT),'0.000') As GhtWt,Format(SUM(A.RTN_GHIS),'0.000') As Ghis,Format(SUM(A.RTN_CHOL),'0.000') As Chol FROM (MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' ? C ? AND C.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ?

UPDATE MFG_MAST SET MFG_MAST.BOOK_SNAME = B.BOOK_SNAME FROM MFG_MAST,BOOK_DATA AS B WHERE MFG_MAST.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND MFG_MAST.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK AND MFG_MAST.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.LC_CODE = '00'
SELECT BOOK_SNAME FROM MFG_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CUR_IN_USE = 'Y' ORDER BY SM_CODE

SELECT A.ITM_LOT AS LOT_NO,B.SM_CODE,B.BOOK_SNAME,A.IR_TYPE,SUM(A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS) As Gwt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.LOT_NO,B.SM_CODE,B.BOOK_SNAME,A.IR_TYPE,SUM(A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS) As Gwt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TOP 1 VCH_DATE FROM MFG_ISU_REC WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? LOT_NO ? ' ORDER BY VCH_TIME
SELECT TOP 1 VCH_DATE FROM MFG_ISU_REC WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND LOT_NO = ' ? LOT_NO ? ' ORDER BY VCH_TIME

SELECT A.ITM_LOT AS LOT_NO,SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.ITM_NWT,-ITM_NWT)) As DiffWt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND A.IR_TYPE <> 'L' ? AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY ITM_LOT ORDER BY ITM_LOT

SELECT A.LOT_NO,SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS,-(A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS))) As DiffWt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND LOT_NO = ' ? ' AND A.IR_TYPE <> 'L' ? AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY LOT_NO ORDER BY LOT_NO

SELECT A.ITM_LOT AS LOT_NO,SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',ITM_NWT,-ITM_NWT)) As DiffWt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND A.IR_TYPE = 'L' ? And AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY ITM_LOT ORDER BY ITM_LOT

SELECT A.AC_NAME FROM PR_DATA AS A INNER JOIN PR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = B.VCH_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.ITM_LOT = ' ? '

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.AC_NAME) AS SrNo,A.ORD_YRCD,A.ORD_DBCD,A.ORD_NO AS LOT_NO,A.ORD_SRNO,A.IT_CODE,A.KR_CODE,B.AC_NAME,A.ENTRY_TYPE,A.VCH_DATE As KrDate,A.TAG_NO as TagLot, A.ITM_PCS As IsuPcs,A.ITM_GWT As IsuGWt,A.ITM_OTH_WT As IsuOth,A.ITM_NWT As IsuNWt, A.ITM_GHT_WT As RecGhat,A.RTN_CHOL As RecChol,A.RTN_GHIS As RecGhis,A.KR_MINO_WT As RecMtrl,A.LBR_AMT As LbrAmt,A.DESIGN_NO,A.ITM_SIZE,Format(A.DM_PCS,'0') As DmPcs,Format(A.DM_WT,'0.000') As DmWt FROM ((MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.KR_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' And D.TRAN_NAME = ' ? ' ? AND A.KR_CODE = ' ? ' ? And A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.AC_NAME

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.AC_NAME) AS SrNo,A.ITM_LOT AS LOT_NO,A.LOT_NO As TagLot,A.IT_CODE,A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,A.IR_TYPE, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.IR_PCS,0)) As IsuPcs,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '-',A.ITM_GWT,0)) As IsuGWt,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '-',A.ITM_NWT,0)) As IsuNWt, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '+',A.IR_PCS,0)) As RecPcs,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_GWT,0)) As RecGWt,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_NWT,0)) As RecNWt, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_GHAT,0)) As RecGhat,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_CHOL,0)) As RecChol,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_GHIS,0)) As RecGhis,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_MTRL,0)) As RecMtrl, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS,-(A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS))) As DiffWt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.KR_AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND A.IR_TYPE <> 'L' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT,A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,A.IR_TYPE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.AC_NAME) AS SrNo,A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,A.IR_TYPE, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.IR_PCS,0)) As IsuPcs,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '-',A.ITM_GWT,0)) As IsuGWt,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '-',A.ITM_NWT,0)) As IsuNWt, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '+',A.IR_PCS,0)) As RecPcs,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_GWT,0)) As RecGWt,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_NWT,0)) As RecNWt, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '+',A.ITM_GHAT,0)) As RecGhat,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_CHOL,0)) As RecChol,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_GHIS,0)) As RecGhis,SUM(IIF(A.ITM_SIGN = '+',A.RTN_MTRL,0)) As RecMtrl, SUM(IIF(ITM_SIGN = '-',A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS,-(A.IR_WT+A.RTN_CHOL+A.RTN_GHIS+A.ITM_GHAT+A.ITM_LOSS))) As DiffWt FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.KR_AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOT_NO = ' ? ' AND A.IR_TYPE <> 'L' GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,A.IR_TYPE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT B.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR AS GroupL,B.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,B.AC_PHONE As PhoneL,B.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY B.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_PHONE,B.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME

SELECT B.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.KR_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR AS GroupL,B.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,B.AC_PHONE As PhoneL,B.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.KR_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_CODE <> '' GROUP BY B.AC_NAME,A.KR_CODE,B.AC_GR,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_PHONE,B.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME

SELECT B.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.KR_AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR AS GroupL,B.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,B.AC_PHONE As PhoneL,B.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.KR_AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_AC_CODE <> '' GROUP BY B.AC_NAME,A.KR_AC_CODE,B.AC_GR,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_PHONE,B.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
SELECT BOOK_SNAME FROM MFG_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_SNAME NOT IN ('MLTNG','GHTIS') AND CUR_IN_USE = 'Y' ORDER BY SM_CODE

SELECT A.VCH_DATE,B.CO_YEAR,B.CO_BOOK,B.VCH_NO,B.OLD_SRNO,B.ITM_GWT As OrdWt,C.BOOK_SNAME,D.AC_NAME,A.ITM_GWT As Gwt,B.DESIGN_NO As OrdDesign FROM ((MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ORD_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ORD_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ORD_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ORD_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO ) LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND B.AC_CODE = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '

UNION ALL SELECT A.VCH_DATE,B.CO_YEAR,B.CO_BOOK,B.VCH_NO,B.OLD_SRNO,B.ITM_GWT As OrdWt,C.BOOK_SNAME,D.AC_NAME,A.ITM_GWT As Gwt,B.DESIGN_NO As OrdDesign FROM ((APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ISU_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ISU_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ISU_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ISU_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO ) LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND B.AC_CODE = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT B.IR_WT FROM MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN MFG_ISU_REC B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.LOT_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ORD_YRCD = ' ? ' AND A.ORD_DBCD = ' ? ' AND A.ORD_NO = ' ? ' AND A.ORD_SRNO = ? AND B.CO_BOOK = '300'

SELECT A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.OLD_SRNO,A.ITM_GWT As OrdWt,C.BOOK_SNAME,D.AC_NAME,SUM(B.ITM_GWT) As Gwt,A.DESIGN_NO As OrdDesign FROM ((SL_ORD_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN MFG_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO AND A.OLD_SRNO = B.ORD_SRNO) LEFT JOIN MFG_MAST AS C ON B.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And B.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,C.AC_NAME As PartyNameL,A.DESIGN_NO As DesignL,A.ITM_SIZE As SizeL,A.ORD_DEL_DATE AS DeliveryL,A.CO_YEAR As YearL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL,A.OLD_SRNO As SrNoM FROM (SL_ORD_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND D.MAIN_BOOK = 'SALES ORDER' ORDER BY A.VCH_NO,A.OLD_SRNO
